why: Skips any pair with a pinned control in it, rather than only a pinned control against scrolling content. The pinned bar is exactly where the floor is most likely to make controls collide: it lays Start and Back out in one wrapping row at the foot of a narrow pane. Two of its own buttons overlapping is a real ownership defect, and this exemption would hide it.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) does not fail scrolled content passing under a pinned action bar, but fails two pinned controls that overlap
